overview: The committee discussed a proposed amendment to the Medford Standard Compensation Ordinance aimed at establishing wage and benefit floors for contracted janitorial and security services. The council voted to keep the matter in committee to allow for further technical review and coordination between city staff and labor representatives.

items.title: Amendment to Chapter 2 Article 5 Division 2: Medford Standard Compensation Ordinance
items.summary: The council discussed establishing a compensation floor for contracted workers to protect union standards and ensure living wages, using benchmarks from the federal Service Contract Act and Boston labor agreements. The matter was kept in committee to allow the Procurement and Facilities departments more time to review enforcement mechanisms, legal implications for existing contracts, and data accessibility.
